title: Bot for pvp
description: A bot that has full netherite armor (not enchanted) and a sword (not enchanted) and a totem, it fights you, until it died
body: It adds a pvp bot that has full unenchanted netherite armor and an not enchanted sword with a totem, you can find him in the spawn egg catogory or search "BOT" I prefer using same gear as him to get a fair fight and he is bad but has a lot of hearts
